summary: Armata Pharmaceuticals, Inc. operates as a clinical-stage biotechnology company that focuses on the development of targeted bacteriophage therapeutics for antibiotic-resistant infections worldwide. It develops its products using its proprietary bacteriophage-based technology. The company's product candidates include AP-SA02 for the treatment of Staphylococcus aureus bacteremia; AP-PA03 for Pseudomonas aeruginosa . The company is based in Los Angeles, California. Armata Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a subsidiary of Innoviva, Inc.
